label: Local existence PSR for contingents: every being contingent at w has some reason for its existence
definition: At one selected world w, every being that exists at w and is absent at some world accessible from w (MODAL_CONTINGENCY_1) has some #312 reason token explaining its existence fact at w. It is the contingent-only, single-world weakening of NoBruteExistenceAt and says nothing about necessary existents, other worlds or the kind of reason.
note: Analyst formulation for the B2 brute-contingency and parity batch (owner direction 2026-11-23); attribution deferred. See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md, 'Brute contingency and parity'.
